verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents event-triggered notification rules. Real-time alerts are configured in the project Notifications menu, and webhooks fire on the same triggers as the other channels, pushing JSON or XML to any arbitrary URL. The PagerDuty integration automatically creates, updates and resolves incidents, so rules on error events can drive real external actions. Missing for 10: documented detail on rule conditions and filters, native in-product actions beyond notifications and integrations (e.g. auto-assign or auto-status changes), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
